register: Neutral-formal; the standard verb for subjecting an activity, market or system to public rules or oversight.
trap: Portuguese regulamentar and French réglementer may prompt reglamentar; in Spanish, regular is the unmarked verb, while reglamentar stresses detailed implementing rules.
example_tl: La Unión Europea pretende regular los sistemas de recomendación sin imponer un modelo editorial único a todas las plataformas del continente.
example_en: The European Union intends to regulate recommendation systems without imposing a single editorial model on every platform on the continent.
cloze: La Unión Europea pretende {{c1::regular}} los sistemas de recomendación sin imponer un modelo editorial único a todas las plataformas del continente.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the teaching value lies in resisting cross-language pressure toward the narrower reglamentar.

register: Critical social-science and media vocabulary; marks the transformation of something into a tradable good, often with a negative evaluation.
trap: Comercializar means to market or sell something; it does not by itself express turning a social good, relationship or activity into a commodity.
example_tl: Las plataformas han mercantilizado la atención pública hasta convertir cada pausa, conversación y desplazamiento en una oportunidad de extracción de datos.
example_en: Platforms have commodified public attention to the point of turning every pause, conversation and journey into an opportunity for data extraction.
cloze: Las plataformas han {{c1::mercantilizado}} la atención pública hasta convertir cada pausa, conversación y desplazamiento en una oportunidad de extracción de datos.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate for the intended critical sense.

register: Neutral; vigilar covers systematic observation by state or private actors, while someter a vigilancia is more explicitly institutional.
trap: French surveiller and Italian sorvegliare do not license a Spanish cognate such as *surveillar; supervisar means oversee, not secretly or systematically monitor.
example_tl: Durante años, las autoridades vigilaron a activistas y periodistas mediante herramientas adquiridas oficialmente para investigar delitos graves y proteger la seguridad nacional.
example_en: For years, the authorities surveilled activists and journalists using tools officially acquired to investigate serious crimes and protect national security.
cloze: Durante años, las autoridades {{c1::vigilaron}} a activistas y periodistas mediante herramientas adquiridas oficialmente para investigar delitos graves y proteger la seguridad nacional.
note: The legacy rendering is accurate. Self-review: replaced the ambiguous provider with public authorities, making the agent and the acquisition of surveillance tools coherent.

register: Neutral in economic and public-policy writing; context determines whether the transfer is presented descriptively or critically.
trap: The infinitival to is not a purpose phrase here: translating it as para produces the malformed headword para privatizar found in the legacy gloss.
example_tl: El Gobierno privatizó la infraestructura de pagos sin establecer salvaguardias que impidieran que el nuevo operador excluyera a competidores y encareciera el servicio.
example_en: The government privatized the payment infrastructure without establishing safeguards to prevent the new operator from excluding competitors and making the service more expensive.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::privatizó}} la infraestructura de pagos sin establecer salvaguardias que impidieran que el nuevo operador excluyera a competidores y encareciera el servicio.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which mistakes the English infinitive marker for the Spanish purpose preposition para. Self-review: replaced the compressed impedir a alguien + infinitive construction with a finite subordinate clause for more idiomatic policy prose.

register: Neutral-critical for a lasting disturbance or radical alteration; avoids the promotional tone that revolucionar often carries in technology discourse.
trap: Interrumpir means stopping an ongoing process or service; it is too narrow when disrupt means profoundly altering an industry, institution or social system.
example_tl: La entrada de fondos especulativos trastocó el ecosistema mediático local, debilitó las redacciones y subordinó la cobertura a métricas de rentabilidad inmediata.
example_en: The arrival of speculative funds disrupted the local media ecosystem, weakened newsrooms and subordinated coverage to metrics of immediate profitability.
cloze: La entrada de fondos especulativos {{c1::trastocó}} el ecosistema mediático local, debilitó las redacciones y subordinó la cobertura a métricas de rentabilidad inmediata.
note: The isolated English prompt is polysemous. This note adopts the lasting industry-change sense supported by the topic; old_back remains valid for interrupting an event or service.

register: Neutral technical usage; cifrar is the established standard term, while encriptar is also accepted and widespread in computing.
trap: Codificar means to encode data in another representation; it does not necessarily mean protecting it cryptographically, so it is not a synonym for cifrar.
example_tl: La aplicación cifra los mensajes de extremo a extremo, pero conserva metadatos suficientes para reconstruir redes de contacto y hábitos de uso.
example_en: The application encrypts messages end to end but retains enough metadata to reconstruct contact networks and patterns of use.
cloze: La aplicación {{c1::cifra}} los mensajes de extremo a extremo, pero conserva metadatos suficientes para reconstruir redes de contacto y hábitos de uso.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; the note distinguishes encryption from mere encoding and records the accepted technical alternative.

register: Neutral-formal in technical and institutional prose; normalizar is also used when a formal standard or common specification is being established.
trap: English standardize, French standardiser and Italian standardizzare can prompt *standardizar; Spanish requires the initial e in estandarizar.
example_tl: El regulador estandarizó los formatos de los informes de transparencia para que periodistas y académicos pudieran comparar las decisiones de moderación entre plataformas.
example_en: The regulator standardized the formats of transparency reports so that journalists and academics could compare moderation decisions across platforms.
cloze: El regulador {{c1::estandarizó}} los formatos de los informes de transparencia para que periodistas y académicos pudieran comparar las decisiones de moderación entre plataformas.
note: The legacy rendering is correct; retention is justified by the cross-language spelling trap and the technical alternative normalizar. Self-review: specified formatos so that both estandarizar and normalizar are idiomatic alternatives in the example.

register: Neutral in media, political and regulatory prose; context usually supplies the negative evaluation.
trap: The English infinitive marker to is not translated with para in a headword; para censurar expresses purpose, not the verb itself.
example_tl: El Gobierno censuró varias investigaciones alegando motivos de seguridad nacional, aunque los documentos retirados solo acreditaban la existencia de contratos opacos con empresas extranjeras.
example_en: The government censored several investigations on national-security grounds, although the withdrawn documents merely established the existence of opaque contracts with foreign companies.
cloze: El Gobierno {{c1::censuró}} varias investigaciones alegando motivos de seguridad nacional, aunque los documentos retirados solo acreditaban la existencia de contratos opacos con empresas extranjeras.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which mistakes the English infinitive marker for the Spanish purpose preposition para. Self-review: added la existencia de because documents establish the existence of contracts rather than accrediting contracts directly.

register: Neutral-critical for extracting unfair advantage from people or circumstances; aprovecharse de foregrounds the abuse more explicitly.
trap: Portuguese explorar and French exploiter should not prompt Spanish explorar or *exploitar here; exploiting workers, resources or dependency is explotar.
example_tl: La plataforma explotó la dependencia económica de sus repartidores para trasladarles los riesgos del negocio sin reconocerles derechos laborales ni capacidad negociadora.
example_en: The platform exploited its couriers' economic dependence to shift business risks onto them without recognizing labor rights or bargaining power.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::explotó}} la dependencia económica de sus repartidores para trasladarles los riesgos del negocio sin reconocerles derechos laborales ni capacidad negociadora.
note: Materially corrects old_back, which turns the headword into a purpose phrase with para. The example fixes the unfair-advantage sense rather than the unrelated sense explode.

register: Neutral in analytical and institutional prose; influir en is more frequent, while transitive influenciar is also standard Spanish.
trap: English influence, French influencer and Italian influenzare favor a direct object; Spanish influir is intransitive and normally governs en or sobre.
example_tl: Los grandes anunciantes influyeron en la cobertura económica al amenazar con retirar campañas de los medios que investigaban sus prácticas fiscales.
example_en: Major advertisers influenced economic coverage by threatening to withdraw campaigns from media outlets investigating their tax practices.
cloze: Los grandes anunciantes {{c1::influyeron en}} la cobertura económica al amenazar con retirar campañas de los medios que investigaban sus prácticas fiscales.
note: The legacy rendering gives the correct verb but omits its required government; the production headword restores en.

register: Neutral; resistirse a expresses refusal or opposition, whereas transitive resistir more often means withstanding pressure, damage or temptation.
trap: English permits resist with a direct object; Spanish normally uses resistirse a for opposing an action, proposal or change, but resistir algo for enduring it.
example_tl: Varias plataformas se resistieron a facilitar datos a los investigadores, pese a haber invocado reiteradamente su compromiso con la transparencia.
example_en: Several platforms resisted providing data to researchers, despite having repeatedly invoked their commitment to transparency.
cloze: Varias plataformas {{c1::se resistieron a}} facilitar datos a los investigadores, pese a haber invocado reiteradamente su compromiso con la transparencia.
note: The source is underspecified. The note selects the common oppose-or-refuse sense; old_back remains valid for the distinct withstand sense.

register: Neutral-formal argumentative usage for disputing the validity of a premise, claim or decision; desafiar is more confrontational.
trap: Desafiar is valid for confronting a rival or defying authority, but it is often a calque when challenge means question a claim or assumption.
example_tl: El informe cuestiona la premisa de que una mayor personalización mejora necesariamente la calidad informativa o fortalece la autonomía de los usuarios.
example_en: The report challenges the premise that greater personalization necessarily improves information quality or strengthens users' autonomy.
cloze: El informe {{c1::cuestiona}} la premisa de que una mayor personalización mejora necesariamente la calidad informativa o fortalece la autonomía de los usuarios.
note: The isolated prompt is polysemous. This note adopts the argumentative sense; old_back is appropriate for confront, defy or issue a challenge.

register: Neutral; the pronominal form is standard when the subject changes in response to circumstances, rules or an environment.
trap: English omits the reflexive marker and the legacy adaptar is only transitive; in the intransitive sense, use adaptarse a something.
example_tl: Los medios locales se adaptaron a las nuevas reglas de distribución sin renunciar a investigar a los actores que financiaban la plataforma.
example_en: Local media adapted to the new distribution rules without giving up investigating the actors that financed the platform.
cloze: Los medios locales {{c1::se adaptaron a}} las nuevas reglas de distribución sin renunciar a investigar a los actores que financiaban la plataforma.
note: The source lacks an object, so the note follows the common intransitive reading and materially expands old_back with the reflexive marker and governed preposition.

register: Neutral-formal for implementing a law, policy or safeguard; implantar is often preferable for installing a system, while implementar is valid but bureaucratic.
trap: Implement is collocationally broad in English: Spanish commonly applies a rule or measure, puts a plan into practice, and installs a system.
example_tl: La comisión aplicó las nuevas salvaguardias de forma gradual para que los medios pequeños pudieran cumplirlas sin abandonar servicios esenciales.
example_en: The commission implemented the new safeguards gradually so that small media outlets could comply with them without abandoning essential services.
cloze: La comisión {{c1::aplicó}} las nuevas salvaguardias de forma gradual para que los medios pequeños pudieran cumplirlas sin abandonar servicios esenciales.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for the policy sense fixed by the example; the register line prevents overgeneralizing it to systems or plans.

register: Neutral in analytical and scientific prose; prever is often used for a reasoned forecast or anticipation and is interchangeable in this example.
trap: Predecir follows decir in key forms: the preterite is predijo, not *predeció, and the past participle is predicho, not *predecido.
example_tl: El modelo predijo un aumento de la polarización, pero sus autores no explicaron qué datos históricos sustentaban una conclusión tan precisa.
example_en: The model predicted an increase in polarization, but its authors did not explain which historical data supported such a precise conclusion.
cloze: El modelo {{c1::predijo}} un aumento de la polarización, pero sus autores no explicaron qué datos históricos sustentaban una conclusión tan precisa.
note: The legacy headword is correct; retention is justified by the high-value irregular morphology demonstrated in the new example.

register: Neutral in economic and public-policy prose; the object of investment may be money, time, institutional capacity or political capital.
trap: Portuguese investir and Italian investire can prompt *investir; Spanish uses invertir and normally introduces the investment target with en.
example_tl: El Estado invirtió en centros públicos de datos para reducir la dependencia tecnológica sin subvencionar otra generación de proveedores dominantes.
example_en: The state invested in public data centers to reduce technological dependence without subsidizing another generation of dominant providers.
cloze: El Estado {{c1::invirtió en}} centros públicos de datos para reducir la dependencia tecnológica sin subvencionar otra generación de proveedores dominantes.
note: The legacy rendering gives the correct verb but omits the governed preposition; the production headword restores en and exposes cross-language interference.

register: Written-formal and often critical; socavar evokes a gradual weakening of authority, legitimacy, rights or institutional capacity.
example_tl: La concentración publicitaria socava la independencia editorial porque permite que unos pocos intermediarios penalicen económicamente a los medios por publicar información incómoda.
example_en: Advertising concentration undermines editorial independence because it allows a few intermediaries to penalize media outlets financially for publishing uncomfortable information.
cloze: La concentración publicitaria {{c1::socava}} la independencia editorial porque permite que unos pocos intermediarios penalicen económicamente a los medios por publicar información incómoda.
note: The legacy rendering is correct. The alternatives are natural in the same sentence, though debilitar states the metaphor less strongly. Self-review: replaced the strained castigar una cobertura with penalizar a los medios por publicar.

register: Neutral-formal; con introduces the other participant and en introduces the project, task or field of collaboration.
trap: French collaborer à and Italian collaborare a can prompt *colaborar a un proyecto; standard Spanish uses colaborar en un proyecto and con a participant.
example_tl: Universidades y redacciones colaboraron con organizaciones civiles en la creación de un archivo público que documenta campañas coordinadas de desinformación electoral.
example_en: Universities and newsrooms collaborated with civil-society organizations to create a public archive documenting coordinated electoral disinformation campaigns.
cloze: Universidades y redacciones {{c1::colaboraron con}} organizaciones civiles {{c1::en}} la creación de un archivo público que documenta campañas coordinadas de desinformación electoral.
note: The legacy rendering is correct but omits its two productive government patterns; the example and cloze restore both. Self-review: expanded en un archivo to the more idiomatic en la creación de un archivo.

register: Neutral-formal, especially common for obtaining entry to data, documents, services, systems or institutional spaces.
trap: English access is transitive, but Spanish acceder is intransitive and requires a before the object; the legacy headword therefore omits essential government.
example_tl: Los investigadores solo accedieron a los registros después de que un tribunal obligara a la plataforma a preservar las pruebas.
example_en: The researchers accessed the records only after a court ordered the platform to preserve the evidence.
cloze: Los investigadores solo {{c1::accedieron a}} los registros después de que un tribunal obligara a la plataforma a preservar las pruebas.
note: Materially expands old_back by adding the governed preposition required in the source sense.

register: Neutral corporate and policy vocabulary in Spain; externalizar stresses moving a function outside, while subcontratar stresses the third-party contract.
trap: Portuguese terceirizar may prompt tercerizar; that form is established in parts of Latin America, while European Spanish normally prefers externalizar or subcontratar.
example_tl: La plataforma externalizó la moderación de contenidos para reducir costes, pero perdió capacidad para supervisar decisiones que afectaban a millones de usuarios.
example_en: The platform outsourced content moderation to cut costs but lost the capacity to oversee decisions affecting millions of users.
cloze: La plataforma {{c1::externalizó}} la moderación de contenidos para reducir costes, pero perdió capacidad para supervisar decisiones que afectaban a millones de usuarios.
note: The legacy rendering is correct for European Spanish; the alternative is interchangeable in the example but foregrounds the contractual arrangement.
